Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities joined to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter to target CHEMBL1892, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and non-null pchembl_value. Use INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Order by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
